plugins.name: fresh-review
plugins.description: Architect-first, fresh-eyes code review: an isolated pass sets an architecture risk tier — low runs the code review on its own; medium and high get a short brief (before and after diagrams in DDD language with no class names, up to two paragraphs, and the PR's screenshots when the UI changed), and high waits for your go. The code review uses context-isolated subagents — a fast implementation pass and the gstack security audit, lattice only when the feature has a lattice context, Codex on request or on high-risk changes. Findings are plain sentences in chat, with the diffs in report.md, and block only with a concrete failure. The gstack review army is opt-in (--army); stack mode plans the reviews of a PR stack; a re-review (--delta) reviews only what changed since the last review and checks the earlier blockers.
